name: Recycle the element base style boxes

atomicDiscipline.rule: Run exactly the printed hypothesis. If the attempted change fails, degrades, or suggests a different fix, revert to the checkpoint and finish this experiment as failure. Start a new experiment for the next idea.

hypothesisMarkdown:
## Recycle the element base style boxes

Mechanism: each element allocated and freed a 720-byte `Box<StyleRefinement>` (its base style) per frame; keep freed boxes in a per-thread pool (8,192) and hand them to the next elements. Allowed: elements/div.rs (`PooledStyle`), uniform_list.rs constructor.
measurementPlanMarkdown: alt2.sh over six scenarios. Pass: div-heavy CPU down at least 3% with allocations down, no extra retained memory.

measurements.metric: geomean of six scenarios, CPU / draw p50

reportMarkdown:
## Recycle the element base style boxes Finished

Passed: false. Allocations fall 6-67% but time does not follow: resetting a recycled 720-byte style on drop costs about what the allocator's malloc and free did, and div-cards draw p50 is 6% worse. The pool also keeps up to 6 MB of boxes for the life of the thread. Reverted.

Attempt Count: 1.
